title: nbn Incident INC000022433100 - Albury, NSW
current_summary: We are aware of an unexpected issue on the access network affecting some services in Albury, NSW. Customers may experience partial or total loss of connectivity. Our team is working with our network partner to restore services as quickly as possible. A restoration time is not yet available.

updates.content: We are investigating a service disruption affecting some services in Albury, NSW. Impacted customers may see slow or no connectivity. Our team is working with our network partner to restore services as quickly as possible. We do not have an estimated restoration time yet and will share updates as soon as we learn more. If available, using mobile data may help you stay online in the meantime. Thank you for your patience.
